description.zh:
用户的账号名称。
<notice>注意：userId和accountName只填一个即可，不填时默认绑定报表的owner，访问报表时将以该用户身份访问。</notice>
description.en:
The name of the user account.
><notice>Note: Specify either UserId or AccountName. If you leave both parameters empty, the ticket is bound to the API caller by default. Access is then granted based on the caller's identity.></notice>

description.zh:
用户的账号类型:

- 1：阿里云主账号

- 3：QuickBI 自建账号。

- 4：钉钉

- 5：阿里云RAM账号

- 6：三方账号（SAML、OAuth等协议对对接的账号）

- 9：企业微信

- 10：飞书

<notice>注意：accountName不为空，则accountType不能为空。</notice>
description.en:
The type of the user account:

- 1: Alibaba Cloud account

- 3: Quick BI user

- 4: DingTalk

- 5: RAM user

- 6: Third-party account (an account integrated using protocols such as SAML or OAuth)

- 9: WeCom

- 10: Lark

><notice>

Note: This parameter is required if you specify AccountName.

></notice>

description.zh: 开通嵌入的智能小Q 模块 ID。
description.en: The ID of the embedded Copilot module.

description.zh:
过期时间。

- 单位分钟，最大240（4小时）。

- 默认240。
description.en:
The expiration time of the ticket.

- Unit: minutes. The maximum validity period is 240 minutes (4 hours).

- Default: 240 minutes.

description.zh:
ticket的票据数量取值范围：

- 默认值为1。

- 建议值为1。

- 最大值为99999。

每次使用票据访问后，Ticket的票据数量减1。
description.en:
The number of times the ticket can be used. The value can range from 1 to 99,999.

- Default: 1.

- Recommended: 1.

- Maximum: 99,999.

Each access decrements the ticket's usage count by one.

description.zh:
Quick BI的UserId，非您的阿里云账号ID。 您可以调用QueryUserInfoByAccount接口，获取UserId。UserId样例为fe67f61a35a94b7da1a34ba174a7****。

<notice>注意：userId和accountName只填一个即可，不填时默认绑定报表的owner，访问报表时将以该用户身份访问。</notice>
description.en:
The ID of the Quick BI user. This is not your Alibaba Cloud account ID. Call the QueryUserInfoByAccount operation to obtain the user ID. Example: `fe67f61a35a94b7da1a34ba174a7****`.

><notice>

Note: Specify either UserId or AccountName. If you leave both parameters empty, the ticket is bound to the API caller by default. Access is then granted based on the caller's identity.

></notice>
